# moodle-cli 0.6.0

## Summary

Adds session keepalive so you no longer re-run SSO (Okta) logins every time. The CLI can renew the Moodle server-side session in the background, keeping the cached `MoodleSession` cookie usable indefinitely.

Also fixes `moodle user` on sites (such as Monash) that disable `core_webservice_get_site_info`.

## Features

- `moodle auth status` — show cached session freshness and the live server-side session state via `core_session_time_remaining` (read-only; does not extend the session).
- `moodle auth keepalive` — renew the session once with `core_session_touch`; if the session is expired, re-authenticate non-interactively from browser/okta cookies (skip re-login with `--no-renew`).
- `moodle auth keepalive install` — register a macOS launch agent that renews the session periodically (default every 30 minutes; `--interval <minutes>`), plus `uninstall` and `status`. On Linux, schedule `moodle auth keepalive --json` with cron.
- `moodle auth login` — force a fresh login and refresh the session cache.

## Fixes

- `moodle user` falls back to scraping the dashboard when `core_webservice_get_site_info` is disabled, instead of failing with `servicenotavailable`.

## Changes

- Raised the local session cache TTL from 2h to 24h; staleness is now validated against the server rather than expiring the cache early.
- Background renewals use non-interactive auth so a dead session can never spawn an interactive Okta prompt from launchd/cron.

## Validation

Validated with:

- `npm run check`
- `npm test`
- `npm run build`
- `npm run pack:check`
- `npm run pack:smoke`
